title: Per-pixel MODIS greenness in every season, 2000 to 2025 (pixel_seasons 1.0.0)
description:
Precomputed result of recipe pixel_seasons 1.0.0 for Ait Bouguemez valley catchment: the March to June mean NDVI of each of the 8094 250 m Terra MOD13Q1 v6.1 pixels that have a Theil-Sen slope in pixel_trend_long_record, for each of the 26 seasons 2000 to 2025, from the same composites, reliability filter and rounding. The Theil-Sen slope recomputed from these values equals the stored slope of every pixel (largest difference 3.7e-09 NDVI per decade). A web copy holds one value grid per season.

Each value is one 250 m MODIS pixel's mean over the composites of one growing window that passed the reliability filter, not a measurement of any field, pasture or plant. A season where fewer than half of the periods were kept at a pixel has no value there. NDVI measures how green the ground looks from above, not forage, palatability or species. Spring windows include snow-covered ground at the upper pixels in some seasons; earlier or later melt can move a season's value with no change in the plants. Terra's overpass has drifted earlier since 2020, from 10:30 to about 9:06 mean local time by December 2025 (NASA): later seasons are seen with a lower sun and longer shadows in mountain terrain, which may shift NDVI without any change on the ground. Composites from 12 July 2025 to the end of 2025 are absent from Planetary Computer; a season window that includes them holds fewer composites. The values are an input to pixel_trend_long_record, not a second analysis. A run of high or low seasons seen when stepping through them is not a trend or a cause; the slope, its interval and the false discovery rate check are in pixel_trend_long_record.

providers.processing:lineage: The cached MOD13Q1 v6.1 NDVI and pixel reliability windows of pixel_trend_long_record (584 Terra composites, no new download); growing-window season means per pixel as in that recipe, stored as a float32 GeoTIFF and a web array, and the Theil-Sen slope recomputed from them for every pixel (science/pipeline/pixel_seasons.py).

pixel_seasons.title: Summary: per-season counts and statistics, the slope check against the trend raster, absent composites (the result read_recipe_result returns)

pixel_seasons_grid.title: Native 250 m MOD13Q1 grid, one float32 band per season 2000 to 2025: March to June mean NDVI (NaN = no value)

pixel_seasons_bin.title: Season values as a little-endian float32 array seasons x rows x columns, NaN = no value (web copy of pixel_seasons_grid)

pixel_seasons_bin_header.title: Header of pixel-seasons.bin: CRS, transform, shape, season years, counts, source checksums

siterra:dataset.access_route: https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1 collection modis-13Q1-061, assets 250m_16_days_NDVI and 250m_16_days_pixel_reliability, anonymous SAS-signed COG range reads
siterra:dataset.resolution_note: Native 250 m MODIS sinusoidal grid (231.66 m cells), 16-day composites; display overviews on a 30 m EPSG:3857 grid

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Count of 10 m analysis pixels whose centres fall inside the frozen polygon, EPSG:32629

operation_order: Pixels, composites, reliability filter and season mean are exactly those of pixel_trend_long_record 1.0.0: NDVI(p, c) = DN / 10000 for Terra MOD13Q1 v6.1 composite c and 250 m pixel p, kept only where the composite's pixel reliability is 0 or 1 and -0.2 <= NDVI <= 1.0; G(p, y, W) = mean of the kept NDVI(p, c) over the 16-day periods starting in a month of the growing window W in year y, defined only when at least half of those periods (rounded up) are kept at p

Window and years: the growing window marked primary in the pixel_trend_long_record block of the place configuration (Ait Bouguemez: March to June, mar_jun) and its seasonYears (2000 to 2025); no other window is stored

Values: G(p, y, W) rounded to 5 decimals in the precision of the array it is computed in (float64), for every MOD13Q1 pixel holding at least one 10 m analysis cell of the catchment, for every season year; an undefined G is stored as no value, never as zero

Stored forms: a GeoTIFF on the native MOD13Q1 grid with one float32 band per season year (nodata NaN); a web copy, a little-endian float32 array of shape seasons x rows x columns, season 0 the first season year, row 0 north, NaN for no value, with a JSON header (CRS, transform, shape, season years, pixel counts). Each is read back and must equal the computed values cell for cell

Check against the stored trend: for every pixel with at least min_seasons defined seasons, the Theil-Sen slope of the stored values on the year (the pixel_trend_long_record method, NDVI per decade) is compared with band 1 of the pixel_trend_long_record GeoTIFF of the same window; the largest absolute difference must be at most 1e-6 NDVI per decade and the set of pixels with a slope, and each pixel's number of seasons (band 4), must be identical. Any difference stops the run

Summary: per season, the number of pixels with a value, and the mean, median and the 5th and 95th percentiles over those pixels (unweighted by cells); the composite periods absent from the archive read, from the same record as pixel_trend_long_record

siterra:checks.name: recompute_sample_period
siterra:checks.detail: The Theil-Sen slope of the stored values of all 8094 trend pixels, recomputed from the web array, equals band 1 of the bundle_pixel_trend_long_record_ait_bouguemez raster for mar_jun: largest difference 3.69e-09 NDVI per decade (tolerance 1e-06); the pixels with a slope and every pixel's season count are identical.

siterra:checks.name: units_and_scale
siterra:checks.detail: Stored NDVI is the physical value (DN / 10000) averaged over the kept composites and rounded to 5 decimals; every stored MOD13Q1 window is int16 with nodata -3000 and GDAL scale 10000 (scale encodings seen: 2). The float32 array and the GeoTIFF equal the computed values cell for cell.

siterra:checks.name: nodata_not_zero
siterra:checks.detail: A season with fewer than the composite share of kept composites at a pixel is stored as NaN, never as zero; NDVI fill (-3000), values outside -0.2 to 1.0 and reliability other than 0 or 1 are not observed.

siterra:checks.name: qa_join_coverage
siterra:checks.detail: All 584 composites share one 176 x 131 pixel window grid; 8094 MOD13Q1 pixels hold catchment cells and 8094 have 15 or more seasons. In the registered growing window: No composite period is absent from Planetary Computer in the registered period.
